title: 第9章 楚幼微感觉自己又行了普信女的世界很无敌第10章 给老子滚蛋陈稳终醒来
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
楚北穹深吸一口气，“解铃人还需系铃人。”
“别绕了，说直白点。”罗浩急声道。
这时，连秦牧也看向楚北穹。
楚北穹继续道，“就是说，只要小微能得到那小子的原谅，我们就能有一线生机。”
罗浩眉头轻皱，“那小子是舔狗，可又不是傻子。”
“我们对他如此的残忍，这事真能揭过去？”
“也许换作正常人，这可能就真不行了，但那小子还真就不是正常人。”
说着，楚北穹嘴角便扯着一丝嘲弄，继续道：“这些年来，那小子为了讨好小微，做过太多太多刷新人类下限的事了。”
“所以，只要小微肯服软，并向他撒撒娇，这事并不是没有揭过去的可能。”
“当然了，你觉得还有更好的办法，就当我什么也没说。”
我……
罗浩顿时说不出话来了。
他有个屁的办法啊。
远处已经恢复过来的楚幼微，则是脸色复杂，不知在想什么。
因为没人比她更清楚，陈稳对她的好了。
罗浩沉默了许久，也下定了决心。
事到如今，他也只能赌上一次了。
哪怕只有一线希望。
他也不想死。
念及此，他才走向楚幼微，并恭敬地将其扶起，“小师……不……楚小姐，您没事吧。”

楚幼微摇了摇头，此时她已不复之前的惨状。
“楚小姐，还请您务必替我求一下情。”
“只要我不死，我愿意在您身边做牛做马。”
罗浩郑声道，态度极其的诚恳。
“楚小姐，还有我，刚不久是我态度不好，我在这向您道歉。”
“这是我的一点心意，还请您能收下。”
“还有，只要这次我能活下来了，我这条命就是您的了。”
秦牧挣扎地走了过来，并将自己的空间戒奉上。
此时此刻，他也和罗浩是一样的心境。
楚幼微淡淡地看了秦牧一眼，这才拿过空间戒。
看着眼前这两个高高在上的人，都在向自己低头哈腰。
楚幼微突然觉得这才是她梦想中的向往。
content_en:
Chu Beiqiong took a deep breath and said, "The person who untie the bell also needs the person who tied the bell."
"Stop beating around the bush and speak more frankly." Luo Hao said urgently.
At this time, even Qin Mu looked at Chu Beiqiong.
Chu Beiqiong continued, "That is to say, as long as Xiao Wei can get that kid's forgiveness, we can have a chance of survival."
Luo Hao frowned slightly, "That guy is a licker, but he's not a fool."
"We were so cruel to him, can this really be revealed?"
"Perhaps for a normal person, this might not be possible, but that kid is really not a normal person."
As he spoke, Chu Beiqiong's lips twitched with a trace of mockery as he continued: "Over the years, in order to please Xiaowei, that boy has done too many things that have pushed the limits of human beings."
"So, as long as Xiaowei is willing to give in and act coquettishly to him, there is no possibility that this matter will be solved."
"Of course, if you think there is a better way, just pretend I didn't say anything."
I...
Luo Hao was suddenly speechless.
He has a fucking idea.
Chu Youwei, who had recovered from the distance, had a complicated expression and didn't know what he was thinking.
Because no one knows better than her that Chen Wen treats her well.
Luo Hao was silent for a long time and made up his mind.
At this point, he can only gamble once.
Even if there is only a glimmer of hope.
He doesn't want to die either.
Thinking of this, he walked towards Chu Youwei and helped her up respectfully, "Little Master... no... Miss Chu, are you okay?"
Chu Youwei shook her head. At this time, she was no longer in the miserable state she was in before.
"Miss Chu, please beg for me."
"As long as I don't die, I'm willing to be a cow and a horse by your side."
Luo Hao said solemnly, his attitude was extremely sincere.
"Ms. Chu, and me, I had a bad attitude just now. I apologize to you here."
"This is a little bit of my thoughts, please accept it."
"Also, as long as I survive this time, my life will be yours."
Qin Mu struggled over and presented his space ring.
At this moment, he was in the same state of mind as Luo Hao.
Chu Youwei gave Qin Mu a faint look before taking the space ring.
Looking at the two high-ranking people in front of him, they were all bowing to him.
Chu Youwei suddenly felt that this was what she longed for in her dreams.
